# odoo-work-cli fields

## NAME

odoo-work-cli-fields - Inspect Odoo model fields

## SYNOPSIS

```text
odoo-work-cli fields MODEL
```

## DESCRIPTION

Print the fields of the Odoo model MODEL with their type, label and
whether they are required. Use it to find the technical field names for
extra_fields and filters in the configuration, e.g. a custom
x_studio_ field.

Common models: project.project (projects), project.task (tasks),
account.analytic.line (timesheet entries), hr.attendance (attendance).

## OPTIONS

None besides the global options.

## GLOBAL OPTIONS

`--backend` *BACKEND*
:   BACKEND: odoo or fake (offline, made-up data; env ODOO_WORK_CLI_BACKEND).

    *string; optional; default: odoo; env: ODOO_WORK_CLI_BACKEND*

`--config` *FILE*
:   Read only the config FILE (skip discovery).

    *string; optional*

`-h`, `--help`
:   Print the help of the command and exit.

## OUTPUT

The columns Field, Type, Label and Required. There is no JSON output.

## ENVIRONMENT

`ODOO_URL`
:   Odoo server URL; overrides url from the config files.

`ODOO_DATABASE`
:   Odoo database name; overrides database.

`ODOO_USERNAME`
:   Odoo login, usually an e-mail address; overrides username.

`ODOO_PASSWORD`
:   Odoo API key, used for XML-RPC. Despite the name, not the login password.

`ODOO_WEB_PASSWORD`
:   Odoo login password, used for the web session of clock in and clock out.

`ODOO_TOTP_SECRET`
:   TOTP secret (base32 or otpauth:// URL) for accounts with two-factor authentication.

`ODOO_OP_TIMEOUT`
:   Timeout of the 1Password call that resolves [op_secrets], a Go duration; default 5s.

`ODOO_WORK_CLI_NO_OP`
:   If 1, true, yes or on, [op_secrets] is ignored and the 1Password CLI is never called.

`ODOO_WORK_CLI_BACKEND`
:   Backend, odoo (default) or fake; --backend overrides it.

`ODOO_WORK_CLI_FAKE_STATE`
:   State file of the fake backend; default odoo-work-cli-fake-state.json in the temporary directory.

`XDG_CONFIG_HOME`
:   Base directory of the global config file; default ~/.config.

## FILES

`~/.config/odoo-work-cli/config.toml`
:   Global configuration ($XDG_CONFIG_HOME/odoo-work-cli/config.toml if XDG_CONFIG_HOME is set). Created by odoo-work-cli config install.

`.odoo-work-cli.toml`
:   Configuration of a directory tree. Every such file from the filesystem root down to the current directory is merged over the global file, the deepest last. --config FILE loads only FILE instead.

`$TMPDIR/odoo-work-cli-fake-state.json`
:   State of the fake backend (--backend fake); ODOO_WORK_CLI_FAKE_STATE sets another path. Delete it to start over with the seed data.

## EXIT STATUS

0 on success, 1 on any error, including usage errors. The error is printed as "Error: TEXT" on standard error.

Error kinds this command can fail with:

`auth`
:   Authentication failed: wrong API key or login password, TOTP rejected.

`validation`
:   Invalid input: unknown flag, bad argument, malformed date, time or hours, a time in the future, an unknown project.

`network`
:   Odoo cannot be reached: DNS, connection refused, timeout, TLS.

`config`
:   The local configuration is missing or invalid.

`secrets_locked`
:   1Password is locked or unreachable, so op:// references could not be resolved.

`internal`
:   Anything else: an unexpected Odoo response or a bug.

## EXAMPLES

The fields of a project:

```console
$ odoo-work-cli fields project.project
Field                          Type            Label                          Required
------------------------------ --------------- ------------------------------ --------
name                           char            Name                           true
partner_id                     many2one        Customer                       false
company_id                     many2one        Company                        false
```
